_note: The PINNED design system for Compass's own artefacts (Brief, Plan Map, Release Card, Review). Produced ONCE by an artifact-design pass at v0.30 and emitted deterministically by gen.mjs thereafter — never re-designed per build, because a per-build design breaks same-state-to-byte-identical output. Distinct from rk-house-style/neutral-indigo, which stays the system for the PRODUCT UIs Compass builds for users. Two systems, two audiences.

_design_plan.subject: A page an engineer reads to make one decision: lock this spec, approve this plan, or not. Not a dashboard, not marketing. Sustained reading, then a click.
_design_plan.palette: Instrument panel, cool. A slate ground with a teal bias so the neutral reads as chosen rather than inherited, and ONE warm signal — a bearing marker — spent in a single place. Semantic ok/warn/stop are separate from the signal and never double as an accent.
_design_plan.type: Two genuinely distinct voices, no webfont (the Artifact CSP blocks font CDNs and a silent fallback is worse than a system stack chosen on purpose). INSTRUMENT: monospace for labels, counts, verify commands and the decision question — the log voice. READING: a serif for the prose you actually read to decide. Serif for sustained reading is the point; the reader is reading, not scanning.
_design_plan.layout: A bearing sheet. One 65ch reading column, with a left margin rail carrying mono labels and numbers, so prose reads down the centre and instrument values scan in the margin.
_design_plan.deliberately_avoided: The tells artifact-design names: Inter/Space Grotesk as the safe face, indigo-to-purple accent, warm cream + serif + terracotta, an accent bar on rounded cards, emoji section markers, a centered hero, rounded-lg everywhere. The outgoing neutral-indigo theme used four of these.

fontMono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
fontDisplay: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

_dark._note: Redefined TOKENS only. Components are styled through the tokens, never inside a media or [data-theme] block — a colour whose only definition sits behind [data-theme] never applies in the un-stamped 'system' state, which is the classic unreadable-artifact bug.

_a11y.target: WCAG AA — body text >= 4.5:1 against its own surface, large text and UI chrome >= 3:1, in BOTH themes.
_a11y.focus: Every interactive element carries a visible :focus-visible ring in the signal colour; focus is never removed without replacement.
_a11y.motion: Honours prefers-reduced-motion. The pages are static, so this is a declaration that no motion is introduced later without re-checking.
_a11y.checked_by: scripts/contrast-check.mjs, run against the GENERATED artefact's resolved pairs in both themes — never against this file alone, because a token file cannot show a bad pairing that gen.mjs composes.

fontSans: Charter, 'Iowan Old Style', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif
_font_note: `fontSans` is the key anti-drift-grep contracts on; the value here is deliberately a SERIF (the reader is reading to decide, not scanning). The key name is historical, the value is the design decision.
